common_name: Jubilee Celebration Rose (Salmon-Pink David Austin Rose)

planting.note: Set out own-root or container plants in spring or fall in full sun with good air circulation; Jubilee Celebration bears large, rounded, salmon-pink blooms with a golden glow toward the center on a sturdy, well-branched shrub.

directions: Plant in full sun in fertile, well-drained soil enriched with compost. Jubilee Celebration carries large, fully double, rounded blooms in warm salmon-pink with coppery-gold tones deep in the flower, backed by a strong, fruity fragrance with a hint of spice. The vigorous, bushy shrub is clothed in glossy, disease-resistant foliage and produces an unusually heavy flush of bloom for an English rose. It reblooms reliably from late spring through fall; prune canes back by about a third in late winter to encourage strong new flowering wood, and deadhead spent blooms through the season to sustain continued flowering.
sources: American Rose Society — English rose archive
